title: checkout-web: third-party fraud scoring timing out
summary: Everything internal is healthy; the external fraud-scoring provider is timing out. The right move is a degraded-mode fallback, not a restart and not a rollback of an unrelated deploy from three days ago.
symptom: Checkout confirmation takes >8s because the external fraud-scoring call has no answer; customers abandon.
demo_notes: Proves the memory layer does not over-generalise: no deploy correlation, no pool saturation, and the recalled Redis/Postgres precedents are contradicted by healthy internal dependencies.
